purpose: Persist chronology-safe current documentary evidence so RK-MIS can build runway, moat and catalyst histories prospectively under the already-frozen review rubric instead of relying on sparse retrospective reconstruction.

reinvestment_runway_score.method: 20 points per independently approved category, cap 100

moat_evidence_score.method: 20 points per independently approved category, cap 100

new_product_export_optionalities_score.method: 20 points per independently approved category, cap 100

independent_basis_rule: The same factual basis cannot create credit in multiple categories. Cross-category claims sharing the same basis key fail closed until independently supported.
numeric_evidence: Order book, capacity and capex records may be persisted but are not automatically converted into orderbook_to_sales, planned_capacity_increase_pct or capex_execution_score without the required denominator/comparability evidence.
management_execution: Management promise and delivery evidence may be persisted, but promise_delivery_pct remains unavailable unless a separate execution engine establishes at least 3 independently closed commitments and their outcomes. This tracker does not relax that rule.
governance: Governance evidence may be persisted but hard/warning flags remain subject to the existing RK-MIS governance mapping and review process.
point_in_time_rule: A feature snapshot may use only claims whose document_date, known_at and latest review decision are on or before the requested as-of date.
score_rule: Only existing RK-MIS feature names are emitted. Pillar weights and bands are unchanged.
future_holdout_rule: Any return validation must freeze the evidence snapshot before the outcome period under a separate preregistered protocol.
